# Browser libraries

Pinned browser bundles used by Media & Design:

- `pdf-lib` 1.17.1 — MIT
- `qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 — MIT
- `jsQR` 1.4.0 — Apache-2.0
- `lucide` 1.24.0 — ISC
- `three` r184 — MIT (`three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`; see `THREE-LICENSE.txt`). Used by the existing 3D design workspace and optional All Game views.

The bundles are served locally so image, PDF, QR, SVG, and icon workflows do not require a third-party CDN at runtime.
